=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text lo "square-free integers from 1 to 145:"
text hi "square-free integers from 1000000000000 to 1000000000145:"
text upto "square-free integers up to "
text col ": "
note cp marks composites below 10^6 (a prime sieve); sq n becomes 1 when some p^2 divides n, n <= 10^6;
note wn marks the window 10^12 .. 10^12 + 145 the same way. Any square factor of a number up to
note 10^12 + 145 has a prime p <= 10^6 + 1 (p^2 > 10^12 + 145 otherwise), and 10^6 + 1 = 101 * 9901 is composite
global cp uchar 1000001
global sq uchar 1000001
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
fn main to int
wn = new uchar 146 0
base = ulong 1000000000000
p = ulong 2
while le p 1000000 bound 999999
if eq get cp p 0
if le mul p p 1000000
j = mul p p
while le j 1000000 bound 999999
put cp j 1
j = add j p
end
end
q = mul p p
j = q
while le j 1000000 bound 999999
put sq j 1
j = add j q
end
r = rem base q
j = ulong 0
if gt r 0
j = sub q r
end
while le j 145 bound 146
put wn j 1
j = add j q
end
end
p = add p 1
end
emit lo
for i ulong 145
if eq get sq add i 1 0
emit sp
emitu add i 1
end
end
emit nl
emit hi
for i ulong 146
if eq get wn i 0
emit sp
emitu add base i
end
end
emit nl
c = ulong 0
lim = ulong 100
for i ulong 1000000
n = add i 1
if eq get sq n 0
c = add c 1
end
if eq n lim
emit upto
emitu lim
emit col
emitu c
emit nl
lim = mul lim 10
end
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
